Name: Elah, King of Israel
Summary: Elah, son of Baasha, reigned two years in Tirzah and was drinking himself drunk in his steward Arza's house when his chariot captain Zimri conspired and slew him.
KeyStory: Elah slain drunk in Arza's house by Zimri.
RelatedPeople: Baasha, King of Israel; Arza, Steward of Elah; Zimri, King of Israel
LifeLesson: A king found drunk on duty is already dethroned in everything but name.
